text:
devex-max: Quick idea: introduce a per-request routing weight hint header so callers can suggest proportional routing (eg: prefer Dedicated 70% vs Hosted 30%). Helps gradual rollouts and multi-variant A/B without server-side feature flags.

plat-omar: Interesting. Header name suggestion? We already have x-rd-route and x-rd-fallback in discussion elsewhere. Maybe x-rd-route-weight-hint.

eng-lina: Important: this must be advisory only. Server policy needs to cap weights (no cost-override), otherwise customers could steer traffic to expensive regions. Also we'll need telemetry fields: routing.hint and routing.final_route_percent.

pm-elaine: From product: this could unlock smoother canaries for customers. UX ask: in Console show a heatmap of actual final route percentages vs hints. Also need a clear disclaimer for SLA/billing differences.

ts-maintainer-lee: For TS client: API shape? Send JSON map like '{"dedicated":0.7,"hosted":0.3}' as header string? Or compressed base64? JSON is easiest for observability. Example header:

  x-rd-route-weight-hint: '{"dedicated":0.7,"hosted":0.3}'

py-maintainer-ana: Python okay with JSON. Semver: additive header -> minor bump. But we should gate behind an SDK opt-in flag and enable telemetry only when opt-in is true.

devex-max: Agreed: SDKs -> minor release, opt-in flag default false. When enabled SDK attaches header and emits a debug log entry with hint summary. Also SDKs will validate sum(weights) ~ 1.0 and drop/normalize otherwise.

eng-lina: Telemetry: sample 1% of requests for full hint->final mapping to avoid cardinality. Emit metrics: routing.hint_present (bool), routing.hint_vector (hashed signature), routing.final_distribution (coarse buckets). TTL on raw hint events = 30 days.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy scheduled for routing-weight-hint branch at 1719002300. Integration tests include header parsing, normalization, and telemetry sampling.

plat-omar: Edge-case: weighted hints + sticky sessions. If a user expects session affinity, server should ignore weight hints after affinity established. Need to document this caveat in client docs.

pm-elaine: Good catch. Console should show "weight hints ignored due to affinity" in route inspector when applicable.

ts-maintainer-lee: I'll open the TS PR with a small helper: setRouteWeightHint({dedicated:0.7, hosted:0.3}) -> validates and toggles header. Include example in README and migration note.

py-maintainer-ana: Py PR next sprint. I'll add runtime warning if opt-in true and weights invalid. Also will expose a function to get last-response headers so apps can inspect x-rd-final-distribution.

devex-max: Action items: 1) eng-lina to add telemetry sampling + coarse metric names, 2) pm-elaine to spec Console heatmap and inspector copy, 3) ts-maintainer-lee & py-maintainer-ana to open opt-in PRs (minor releases), 4) plat-omar to add server-side safety caps. I'll post draft rollout plan after canary run. :thumbsup:
